Definition: from G3956 and G2904; the all-ruling, i.e. God (as absolute and universal sovereign):--Almighty, Omnipotent.
BiblicalUsage: Pantokratōr is the Almighty, the All-Ruler, the Lord God who rules all. He says, I will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters; He is Alpha and Omega, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty; the four living creatures cry Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty; and the great multitude cries Alleluia, for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Almighty is the name that holds everything else. The Father who adopts me is the Ruler of all, and His reign is the end of every story.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
